_readme: Settings and words for the Letter puzzle game (Level 2, the church). words.ar is played in the Arabic app, words.en in the English app; each is grouped by word length in Coptic letters (the Arabic or English word can be any length). Each word: text = shown on the name card, coptic = the answer (for reading only), letters = the answer as letter ids from letters.json (the game uses this). The answer is the word's sounds written in Coptic letters (English words: "Franco English", e.g. Chair = shai ei ro). The tiles are exactly these letters, shuffled. wordsPerRound: words in one round, picked at random from the chosen length. lengths: word lengths offered in the picker (other lengths are kept but not played); the picker also has a Mix level with words of every offered length. A word never comes twice in one round. background: the church picture (drawn in code when missing). Stars: a mistake is a failed check or a hint. 0..threeStarsMaxMistakes = 3 stars, up to twoStarsMaxMistakes = 2 stars, more = 1 star.
